headlines.title: Fed holds interest rates for the fifth meeting this year, underscoring inflation fears
headlines.description: The decision was largely expected by investors, who have seen markets begin to churn amid ongoing concerns about higher oil prices and AI spending.

headlines.title: Pope Leo details family’s slavery history in visit with Tom Llamas
headlines.description: For the first time on camera, Pope Leo XIV discussed his family’s history with slavery. “I come from a family that my grandparents were immigrants. On my mother’s side we have people who were both slaves and slaveowners.” Pope Leo discusses what defines his love for America and his role as the first American pope tonight on “Nightly News”.

headlines.title: Trump’s IRS carveout threatens to hold up Todd Blanche attorney general nomination
headlines.description: WASHINGTON — Todd Blanche’s path to confirmation as the next attorney general of the United States faced a setback Wednesday as two key Republicans pressed the Justice Department to commit in writing to kill an “anti-weaponization” fund that could give money to President Donald Trump’s allies and restrict the scope of the tax audit immunity given to him and his family members.

headlines.title: Dr. Fauci invokes Fifth Amendment over 100 times during Senate hearing
headlines.description: Dr. Anthony Fauci invoked his Fifth Amendment right 106 times during a Senate hearing on the Covid pandemic response. NBC News' Julie Tsirkin reports on the questions Fauci was asked and his opening statement saying Sen. Rand Paul, R-Ky., has an "unhinged obsession" with him.

headlines.title: Jared Leto accused of criminal sexual conduct
headlines.description: Multiple women accused actor and musician Jared Leto of criminal sexual conduct in a new BBC documentary. In a statement, Leto responded that he has “never sexually assaulted anyone.” NBC News' Chloe Melas reports.

headlines.title: Fauci testifies before the Senate on the Covid pandemic
headlines.description: Watch live coverage as Dr. Anthony Fauci testifies before the Senate Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee as part of Committee Chairman Rand Paul's investigation into the origins of Covid. Lawmakers are expected to question Fauci about what he knew and didn't know as the pandemic was unfolding.

headlines.title: St. Paul’s first female Mayor under investigation after police chief’s sexual harassment complaint
headlines.description: The St. Paul, Minnesota, police chief has submitted a sexual harassment complaint against the city’s first female mayor, alleging that she behaved inappropriately toward him and other members of his department, the local NBC affiliate reported Wednesday.

headlines.title: Todd Blanche’s rocky road: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, we dig into the uncertain paths forward for Todd Blanche’s attorney general nomination and the Iran war.

headlines.title: Wife of Kansas City Chiefs OC Eric Bieniemy out of ICU after allegedly being shot by their son
headlines.description: The wife of Kansas City Chiefs offensive coordinator Eric Bieniemy, wounded during a shooting over the weekend at the couple’s Northern Virginia home, has been moved out of intensive care, head coach Andy Reid said Wednesday.

headlines.title: Trump announces plans for sprawling Dulles Airport makeover
headlines.description: President Donald Trump announced a makeover of Dulles International Airport, including construction of terminals and the removal of the airport’s aging shuttles.

headlines.title: Deodorant for kids: Derms talk the right age for deodorant and the best ones for young skin
headlines.description: Kids are hitting puberty earlier — and needing deodorant sooner. Dermatologists share the best kids’ deodorants for sensitive skin, plus when and how kids should start using them.
